Title: Virtual Microphone And A Friendlier Sounds Hub
Changes: Add an opt-in Soundshark Virtual Mic route using VB-CABLE while preserving the experimental physical-microphone option and existing Windows device defaults.
Redesign Soundboard Settings into a cleaner General experience, move playback behavior into it and remove the advanced playback-timing controls.
Expand supported audio conversion and sharing inputs while continuing to export safe, controlled output.
Add optional country flags beside uploader names with a private preference, all 255 bundled country and region flags, and no owner crown.
Add a saved List/Grid selector to Sounds Hub with compact responsive virtualized cards.
Make scrollbars easier to grab and let every slider jump to the pressed position and keep following while dragged.
Improve Sounds Hub compatibility and diagnostics for older or partially deployed profile services.

Title: Custom Libraries And Studio Controls
Changes: Switch Library between Grid and List views, with saved drag ordering, floating drag previews and animated neighboring rows. Performance Mode disables drag arranging and its animations.
Track play counts per sound, keep Library sorting and compact controls together, and preserve custom ordering across searches, refreshes and renames.
Add custom font loading, a main-window light/dark switch and compact Studio and footer layouts.
Add Studio track volume beside Zoom and Scroll, controlled loudness for loud imports, and a compact waveform fitted to the full track.
Move Discord Soundboard into Studio and simplify soundboard settings; configure held push-to-talk keys separately for each sound and capture keyboard and mouse shortcuts directly.
Add Issues & Suggestions with up to five log attachments, private owner report review and owner moderation tools and crown.
Limit suggestions to five per 24 hours and problem/sound reports to six per 12 hours, with owner exemption. Hosted enforcement requires the accompanying SQL and Edge Function deployment.
Include Sounds Hub account sign-in, email verification, password recovery, remembered sessions, catalogue refresh and account validation improvements.

Title: Sounds Hub And Smoother Account Flows
Changes: Added Sounds Hub to browse community sounds, preview them, share your own clips and download sounds into Library.
Sign in with your username or email before opening the Hub, with an optional encrypted remembered login lasting 30 days.
Create an account in a dedicated form, then verify your email in a separate code window with a three-attempt limit.
Reset your password in a separate window with account matching, green confirmation buttons, a 60-second resend cooldown and three token attempts.
Added red validation errors, Caps Lock warnings and a clear error when a new password matches the current password.
Added Refresh Sounds and automatic catalogue refresh after uploads and deletions.
Aligned Sign In, Create Account and Forgot Password with matching button dimensions.
Explained private sound reports and the three-reporter moderation threshold; reporting does not send email notifications.

Title: Library First-Open Fix
Changes: Fixed a null-reference error when opening the Library for the first time after launch.
Initialize the tile panel item generator before measuring existing sounds.
Added regression coverage for first-open keyboard focus and repeated tab switching without prewarming the Library visual tree.

Title: A Denser Sound Library
Changes: Replaced full-width sound rows with a responsive tile grid that fits more sounds on screen.
Kept Preview and Play Through Mic on every tile; moved Stop and Shortcut into the three-dot menu.
Reduced header spacing and preserved custom colors, grouping, themes and text sizing.
Virtualized large collections and preserved scroll position during unchanged file-watcher refreshes.

Title: Mouse Shortcuts And Faster Exit
Changes: Removed a UI-thread log-flush wait cycle that delayed closing and immediate relaunch.
Added global mouse-button shortcuts with modifiers, playback routes, conflict checks and pass-through settings.
Capture middle and side buttons in shortcut boxes; right-click the box to choose any mouse button explicitly.
Automatic input bindings can also hold or tap mouse buttons, with balanced release cleanup.

Title: Library Colors And Playback Controls
Changes: Added Button Color to each sound's three-dot menu, with a color wheel, live preview and Use Default.
Save colors per sound, choose readable button text automatically, and group matching sounds with Group By Color.
Added a Stop button beside each sound's playback actions.
Aligned the Studio audio-device selector and corrected maximized bounds after startup or display changes to keep footer buttons visible.

Title: Smarter Update Checks
Changes: Check installed import tool versions before downloading and leave current or newer tools untouched.
Download only the outdated import tool, reusing its current companion.
Give available app and import tool updates a green breathing glow, with a steady glow for Performance Mode.
Run automatic update checks once at startup instead of repeating every four hours.
Renamed Reduce Motion to Performance Mode while preserving saved preferences.

Title: Update And Roll Back Soundshark
Changes: Renamed Update App to Update Soundshark with an inline update icon and a larger button.
Added Roll Back Soundshark to restore the previous verified app version while keeping Library sounds and settings.
Pause automatic updates after rollback until you choose to update again.

Title: Visible Maximized Controls
Changes: Keep the maximized window inside the current monitor work area so bottom buttons stay above the taskbar.
Wrap footer controls within the available width and separate the update button rows.

Title: Import Tools Download Progress
Changes: Added the matching green download progress display to Update Import Tools.
Show download percentages, verification and testing stages, with cancellation that retains the previous tools.

Title: Update Log And Automatic Updates
Changes: Added a version-by-version Update Log.
Added Update App and automatic GitHub release checks, background downloads and updates on exit.
Fully replace program files while preserving Library sounds, settings and microphone setup.
Match app downloads to the green URL import progress display.
Open Soundshark maximized by default.

Title: Simple Sound Output Volume
Changes: Replaced advanced loudness controls with one 0–100% output slider.
Automatically balance loudness, limit peaks and protect very short clips.
Local monitoring follows the output volume; 0% mutes sound clips.

Title: Playback Volume Rollback
Changes: Restored previous automatic volume defaults while investigating Discord playback.
Later testing confirmed Discord Noise Suppression was filtering affected clips.

Title: Quiet Sound Boost
Changes: Raised automatic microphone sound loudness and maximum boost for quiet clips.
Kept peak protection and original Library files intact.

Title: Global Soundboard Settings
Changes: Moved Soundboard Settings beside Audio Converter.
Added a Shortcut button for each Library sound with Mic, Preview and Both routing.
Kept global hotkey controls together and preserved existing assignments.

Title: Readable Library Menus
Changes: Fixed the white area covering items in the three-dot menu.
Made the popup follow dark and light themes.

Title: More Colors And Fonts
Changes: Added a color wheel, brightness control, hex colors and 24 swatches.
Expanded to 12 bundled font families plus installed Windows text fonts.

Title: Compact Library And UI Settings
Changes: Replaced large sound cards with compact, virtualized rows and live search.
Added saved theme, accent, font, size, spacing and motion preferences.
Kept Preview and Play Through Mic visible; moved other actions into a menu.

Title: Live Clipper Status
Changes: Replaced the Clipper countdown with a continuous live indicator.
The rolling audio buffer keeps listening and discards older audio.

Title: PC Audio Clipper
Changes: Added opt-in Clipper for the last 1–60 seconds of PC audio.
Keep a bounded rolling buffer in memory and bring clips into The Studio.

Title: Microphone EQ And Save Protection
Changes: Added five-band voice EQ with presets.
Automatically reduce overly loud saved and converted audio and verify the encoded result.
Preserve quiet recordings and original files.

Title: Physical Microphone Playback Fix
Changes: Fixed Windows activation of the microphone component.
Verified local physical-microphone playback, pause, resume and Stop.

Title: Experimental Microphone Setup
Changes: Added the approved experimental unsigned microphone setup with backup and removal support.
Preserved existing microphone effects and added setup diagnostics.

Title: Soundboard And Hotkeys
Changes: Added Library Preview and Play Through Mic actions.
Introduced soundboard routing, keyboard shortcuts, push-to-talk and playback timing.
Built the native physical-microphone component; setup and testing continued in later versions.

Title: Clearer Selection Controls
Changes: Show precise selection controls below the track.
Renamed Trim to Trim Selected and standardized button titles.
Added proper arrow and grab cursors over the waveform and selection handles.

Title: Smoother Playback Line
Changes: Moved the playhead using the audio device clock and lightweight rendering.
Improved smoothness without rebuilding the waveform during playback.

Title: Simpler Recording And Trimming
Changes: Made audio device selection always visible.
Added Trim and Keep Selected with Undo/Redo.
Applied the global Discord recording limit to both PC Audio and Microphone.
Removed recovery buttons, zoom/scroll sliders and manual quality choices.

Title: The Studio
Changes: Merged Editor and Booth into The Studio.
Added a PC Audio / Microphone recording source selector.
Kept Library and Audio Converter as the other two tabs.

Title: Friendly Errors And Logs
Changes: Added rotating diagnostic logs, clean error messages and Open Logs.
Added a microphone icon and red/green recording indicator to Record PC Audio.

Title: Cleaner Window And Tooltips
Changes: Fixed unreadable hover text.
Added a black title bar and removed superseded slogans.
Renamed Import Audio to Upload Audio.

Title: Simpler Audio Converter
Changes: Reduced conversion to upload, choose format and convert with automatic quality settings.
Added seven output formats and safe duplicate filenames.
Made Discord Soundboard global, automatically selecting MP3 and enforcing final save limits while keeping full previews.

Title: Clear Booth Audio
Changes: Added Delete All to the Booth with Undo support.

Title: Empty Startup And Clear Recording
Changes: Started Editor and Booth with empty tracks.
Simplified recording labels and quality labels.
Added red idle and green pulsing recording indicators.

Title: Replay And Import Feedback
Changes: Rewind finished clips so Play starts them again.
Added Delete All in Editor and inline URL import progress.

Title: Initial Soundshark
Changes: Introduced local audio editing, PC audio recording and microphone recording.
Added waveform selection, trimming, Undo/Redo, URL imports, Library and conversion.
Packaged the Windows app as an installer and portable version.
